clips.title: The story
paras: Off Darkshore, Mist Veil's Lockbox lies in the sunken night elven vessel. It holds the captain's log and personal effects, lost when coastal murlocs ambushed and sank the ship.

The night elven vessel Mist Veil sank while sailing toward Auberdine. Coastal murlocs ambushed it alongside its sister ship, the Silver Dawning, and overwhelmed both vessels. The captain perished in the attack. Their logbook and personal belongings remain sealed in the lockbox in the flooded hold, surrounded by murlocs.

Surviving sailors reached Auberdine, but the loss of their vessel and commander still grieves them. Gorbold Steelhand seeks Mist Veil's Lockbox so the captain's final effects can be honored and laid to rest. Recovering it from the flooded wreck may bring some solace to the survivors on the mainland.
